sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Bluetooth LE 連線事件：每事件有效負載
related.titleEn: Bluetooth LE connection events: useful payload per event
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 500 ms mean opportunity spacing 與 200 ms mean opportunity spacing，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 500 ms mean opportunity spacing and 200 ms mean opportunity spacing, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋53333.3333333 bit/s與26666.6666667 bit/s，建立ble_events.csv、成功包計數、事件時間軸，並完成以下驗收：40 kbit/s需求只有30 ms組名義可達；需再確認接收端處理與實際事件包數。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 53333.3333333 bit/s and 26666.6666667 bit/s; create ble_events.csv, successful-packet counts and event timeline; apply this acceptance decision: Only30 ms nominally meets40 kbit/s; verify receiver processing and actual packets per event.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 假設每次廣播獨立落入掃描窗口，成功機率p等於掃描占空比，平均嘗試1/p；真實排程相關須另分析。 展開基準式 100/0.2；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以幾何分佈前幾次成功機率加總並保留尾項；另造固定相位永遠錯開的反例說明獨立假設。 將兩條推導一起存入 ble_discovery.csv、掃描窗口圖、固定相位反例。

從原理 應用資料率取決於每事件成功payload與事件頻率；連線間隔較短並非自動提高無限制吞吐。 展開基準式 2*100*8/0.03；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：在600 ms窗列20與10事件，累加4000與2000 byte；同時計算事件數不可四捨五入任意增加。 將兩條推導一起存入 ble_events.csv、成功包計數、事件時間軸。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Assume each advertisement independently lands in a scan window with probabilityp equal to scan duty; mean attempts are1/p, while real schedule correlations need separate analysis., expand baseline expression 100/0.2; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum early geometric probabilities with a tail term; construct a fixed-phase miss example to expose the independence assumption. Save both derivations with ble_discovery.csv, scan-window diagram and fixed-phase counterexample.

Starting from Application rate depends on successful payload per event and event frequency; shorter intervals do not imply unlimited throughput., expand baseline expression 2*100*8/0.03; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate20/10 events in600 ms and sum4000/2000 bytes; do not round event counts upward without a schedule. Save both derivations with ble_events.csv, successful-packet counts and event timeline.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Telstar 轉發器：上行與下行雜訊合併
related.titleEn: Telstar repeater: combining uplink and downlink noise
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 500 ms mean opportunity spacing 與 200 ms mean opportunity spacing，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 500 ms mean opportunity spacing and 200 ms mean opportunity spacing, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋50 linear C/N與20 linear C/N，建立telstar_noise.csv、雜訊倒數帳本、分段監測，並完成以下驗收：線性C/N至少30的教學門檻只第一組通過；未包含轉發器互調及功率回退。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 50 linear C/N and 20 linear C/N; create telstar_noise.csv, reciprocal-noise ledger and segment monitoring; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first meets a linearC/N target30; transponder intermodulation and backoff remain excluded.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 假設每次廣播獨立落入掃描窗口，成功機率p等於掃描占空比，平均嘗試1/p；真實排程相關須另分析。 展開基準式 100/0.2；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以幾何分佈前幾次成功機率加總並保留尾項；另造固定相位永遠錯開的反例說明獨立假設。 將兩條推導一起存入 ble_discovery.csv、掃描窗口圖、固定相位反例。

從原理 透明轉發鏈路的獨立雜訊以線性倒數相加：1/(C/N)total=1/(C/N)up+1/(C/N)down；不可直接加dB。 展開基準式 1/(1/100+1/100)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：將總倒數拆成上/下行兩份；總C/N必須低於最差單段，否則合併方法有誤。 將兩條推導一起存入 telstar_noise.csv、雜訊倒數帳本、分段監測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Assume each advertisement independently lands in a scan window with probabilityp equal to scan duty; mean attempts are1/p, while real schedule correlations need separate analysis., expand baseline expression 100/0.2; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum early geometric probabilities with a tail term; construct a fixed-phase miss example to expose the independence assumption. Save both derivations with ble_discovery.csv, scan-window diagram and fixed-phase counterexample.

Starting from Independent noise in a transparent relay combines through reciprocal linearC/N:1/total=1/uplink+1/downlink; do not add dB ratios., expand baseline expression 1/(1/100+1/100); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Split total inverseC/N into two contributions; total must be lower than the weakest individual segment. Save both derivations with telstar_noise.csv, reciprocal-noise ledger and segment monitoring.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
